name: Article 3 – § 1 – point 1 – point b – point ii; Article 5 – paragraph 2 – point b – point ii – 75
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: Amendment (7a) in Article 14(4), point (b) is replaced by the following: ‘(b) meet with the representatives appointed by the company to discuss actual or potential severe adverse impacts that are the subject matter of the complaint, and potential remediation in accordance with Article 12;’
